newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sony shares hit record high in early Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Sony shares hit record high in early Tokyo.

text.p: Shares in Sony Corp soared to a record high in early Tokyo morning trade on Tuesday.
The rise reflected a recent trend of active investor bidding for blue-chip shares, brokers said.
Sony's shares soared as high as 9,510 yen soon after the Tokyo market opening, compared with their Friday close of 9,360 yen. As of 0011 GMT, the shares stood at 9,490 yen with turnover of 459,000.
Sony shares surpassed the previous record high of 9,500 yen marked on October 11, 1989.

Other Japanese blue chip shares such as Matsushita Electric Industrial Co Ltd, Hitachi Ltd and NEC Corp also gained upward momentum early on Tuesday, helped by the recent weakness of the yen which makes their products more competitive abroad, brokers said.
The rally in blue chips helped propel the market's benchmark Nikkei 225 share average above 20,000 on Tuesday for the first time since the middle of December last year.

Matsushita shares were up 90 yen at 2,240 yen, their highest level for this calendar year, as of 0048 GMT. Turnover was 3.51 million, the sixth largest volume on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange. -- Tokyo Equities Desk +81-3-3432-9404
